name: Event_ActorSlot_PlaySe
summary: Resolves the event actor slot at (work+8)->f_6C (slots f_430/f_434, stride 0x10), validates the attached gadget handle, and posts a sound-effect request {0xFF, modelByte+0x532, seId} through func_005F7F78.
evidence: Event actor slot walk (f_430/f_434, stride 0x10) matches the established event-state layout; caller Event_DispatchHandlerByte4; the three-byte request ends in seId, so it is a per-actor SE post.

name: maybe_Event_ActorSlot_PlaySeEx
signature: void Event_ActorSlot_PlaySeEx(int actorIndex, u8 first, u8 b, u8 c)
summary: Same event-actor-slot resolution as 0x0014B878 but forwards the three caller bytes {first, c, b} to func_005F7F78; a variant SE/parameter post for an event actor.
evidence: Identical slot/handle validation idiom as 0x0014B878; no callers and func_005F7F78's exact meaning unproven, so the 'sound' part stays tentative.

name: Battle_Party_IsAnyMemberActorBusy
summary: In 3D battle mode (flag +0x4244), walks the party list at +0x4260 and returns 0 if any active member's actor is still busy (handle lookup plus func_00669BAC/func_0066A2BC); otherwise returns 1.
evidence: Battle work +0x5C, mode byte +0x4244 and party list +0x4260 are established; the body only tests actor busy state, not sound, so the old 'Sound' wording is dropped.

name: maybe_Battle_Party_IsAnyMemberActorBusyEx
summary: Variant of 0x0016A2C8 that additionally skips members whose status query (vtable +0xE8 with 0x9A) is set, then applies the same actor-busy checks.
evidence: Same battle-work/party-list structure as 0x0016A2C8 with an extra status 0x9A filter; no callers to pin the exact purpose.

name: maybe_HandleTable_ReleaseAllLiveEntries
summary: Iterates the tracked-handle table (count at +0x18, handles at +0x8 stride 8), and for each entry still live in the global handle registry calls Field_Actor_PlayTalkMotionFromTable(obj, 3) and marks the slot released (+0xC = 1).
evidence: Registry/generation check plus per-slot released flag are clear; the action value 3 passed to 0x5F5B94 is not proven to be a release, so the name stays generic.

name: Actor_SetMotionAndPostSe2F
summary: Validates the actor's +0x110 handle, calls Field_Actor_SetMotionState on the linked object, then posts sound effect 0x2F on it via func_005E7848.
evidence: Both callees are named; the constant 0x2F is the only sound id, so 'hook' is unverified but the motion+SE pair is supported.

name: UiPart_SetHandleFlag
signature: void UiPart_SetHandleFlag(UiPart* self, u32 handle, u8 flag)
summary: If the passed handle is still live in the global handle table, notifies the bound object through vtable +0x7C, then stores the boolean at self+0x234.
evidence: Body only validates the handle and writes a flag at +0x234; caller Ui_StreetPassVipMsg_Ctor; the same idiom recurs at 0x2117C4/0x2128D0.

name: maybe_Anim_ApplyTrackPoseThumb
summary: Damaged thumb decompilation of an animation-track pose application routine; unaff_ registers and fake args prevent a reliable reading.
evidence: Body is full of unaff_rN/in_ZR/arg5..arg7 and a mis-detected boundary; only the 0x60-stride track walk resembles 0x00267FF0.

name: maybe_Anim_ApplyTrackPose
summary: Walks up to two track ids from self->f_cc, resolves each 0x60-byte animation record via self->f_1c and writes its position into the target object, then applies the transform and sets the needs-update byte.
evidence: 0x60 stride record reads f_10/f_20/f_30, handle-table validation, single caller maybe_Ui_BattleTargetMarker_CreateFromModelRecord; animation table only reached via hash constants.

name: maybe_Anim_ApplyActionToMatchingHandles
signature: void maybe_Anim_ApplyActionToMatchingHandles(UiAnimOwner* self, int startIndex, int endIndex)
summary: Scans 0x40-byte handle entries at self+0x160 in [start,end), then walks the two field object lists (filter 4) to find the live object matching f_154/f_158 and state bytes, reconciling entries against its handle.
evidence: Handle-range scan and 0x40-stride slot array confirmed; object match on f_154/f_158 and +0x25A/+0x26A state bytes; no callers.

name: Ui_DiveStartWindow_SetRecordHandle
signature: void maybe_Ui_DiveStartWindow_SetRecordHandle(UiDiveStartWindow* self, u32 record_handle, u8* flag)
summary: Validates a tagged record handle against the global handle table and, when valid, notifies the record object at self->f_2d4 through vtable+0x7C; then stores the caller's flag in self+0x284.
evidence: Same guarded handle test as Ui_MessageWindow_SetRecordHandle (0x00316994); callers Ui_WindowHolder_Ctor and maybe_Ui_DiveStartWindow_CreatePartB.

name: maybe_Ui_Actor_CalcOverlayPosition
summary: Resolves the object behind the UI context handle (work+0x48+0x3B4) through the class hash table and derives an overlay anchor from that object's f_A8/+0x78/+0x7C/f_A9/f_AA fields, then continues with anchor math.
evidence: Handle resolution and field reads confirmed; callees include Actor_PlayIdleAnimationForState, Model_CopyRootMatrix, Field_Actor_ComputeCellTransitionOffset; outcome partly unread.

name: maybe_Field_Actor_StopCurrentAction
summary: Resolves the actor's current action through the handle table and cancels it: calls the action's virtual +0x74 with (0,0) and then +0x3C with 4 to finish the state.
evidence: Two virtual calls visible; caller Field_Action_SetRunState; class and meaning of 4 inferred.

name: Battle_Ui_UpdateUnitExpression
summary: Applies the current facial expression to units 1..3: resolves each unit's model through the battle-unit table and applies its expression byte with func_00223084.
evidence: Callers are the battle UI update entry points (Battle_Ui_UpdateStateMachine, ActionUi_Update2D_Part2, ActionUi_Update3D); 0x005F5818 unit->model used as in animation resets; expression setter still unnamed.

name: maybe_Ui_UmaWindow_SetEntryFlag
signature: void maybe_Ui_UmaWindow_SetEntryFlag(UmaPanel* self, u32 handle, u8 flag)
summary: Stores flag in the horse-race panel's entry field self->f_798 and, when handle passes the global handle-table check, notifies the panel's model object through virtual +0x7C.
evidence: Only reference is the ctor maybe_Ui_UmaWindow_Ctor passing its second and third arguments straight through; no named caller/callee confirms semantics.

name: maybe_Ui_Component_FindAndNotify
summary: Finds the object of class g_uiComponentClass behind the handle at work+8->+0x48 +0x20 and calls its vtable +0xBC.
evidence: Handle-table lookup with class-hash walk and vtable+0xBC call; no callers and no new evidence.

name: maybe_Model_IsInstanceRegistered
summary: Lazily builds a shared object when a guard byte is set, then resolves the object at obj[2]+0x6C via Field_FindObjectByMode(...,3) and returns 1 only if the returned handle's generation tag matches the global handle table.
evidence: Calls Field_FindObjectByMode and compares handle>>0xb against the table generation; the singleton it builds is unnamed and the caller Ui_CampSelectWindow_Setup does not pin the semantics.

name: maybe_Actor_PlayEventSe
summary: Validates the handle at self+0x110 against the field object registry and plays a sound effect on it: codes 2/3 -> SE 0x1B (skipped if 0x00669250 reports 0x1C), 0x90 -> 0x1C, 8/9 -> 0x28.
evidence: Handle decode with 0x001FFFFF/generation check, then func_005E7848(handle, seId, 1) with distinct SE ids per event code; no named callers to confirm the event-code mapping.

name: maybe_Ui_Balloon_BindActorHandle
signature: void maybe_Ui_Balloon_BindActorHandle(UiBalloon* self, u8 slot, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, u32 arg5, u32* handle)
summary: If the passed handle resolves in the field object registry, stores the slot index at self+0x839 and sets self+0x838=1, then tail-calls 0x00100B74 with arg3.
evidence: Handle generation test matches the shared registry check, but the function does not store the handle and 0x00100B74 is a shared trampoline/assert path, so 'bind actor handle' overstates the body.

name: maybe_Ui_FaceIcon_SetOnOff
summary: When the cached +0x18 state differs, resolves the render handle, walks the node list and calls vtable +0x70 with the literal node name s_g3085b_off or s_g3085b_off_on, then caches the new state.
evidence: String literals s_g3085b_off / s_g3085b_off_on and the cached isOn flag; callers are generic icon-list/jackpot screens, so 'face icon' is not proven.

name: maybe_Field_Object_UpdateIfActor
summary: If the object has an attached actor (+0xF24), resolves its handle, walks the class chain and, when derived from g_actorBaseClass, calls 0x00669E24 and then 0x00669DD4 if that reports nothing; always returns 1.
evidence: Class comparison against g_actorBaseClass and the two actor update calls; the caller FieldParty_InitMemberSlots does not pin the exact update semantics.

name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_SetCursorMode
signature: void maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_SetCursorMode(MessageWindow* self, u32 handle, int mode)
summary: Resolves an optional handle through the shared handle table (releasing the old object via virtual +0x7C), then stores the mode byte at +0x1943, where 0xFF keeps the previous mode and a stored 2 is promoted to 3.
evidence: Vtable 0x00762F48 places it in the message-window class, but 'cursor/selection mode' is an interpretation of the +0x1942/+0x1943 bytes and there are no callers.

name: maybe_Container_HandleList_ReleaseByType
summary: Walks the handle list at self+0x10, resolves each handle through the global table and, for objects derived from g_actorBaseClass, calls virtual +0x40 with 4 (release), then resets the list to the empty token.
evidence: Handle decode with generation check, class-chain walk against g_actorBaseClass and vtable +0x40(4) release call; the trailing func_003143C0(typeTag) and list reset are consistent but no callers confirm the type filter.

name: maybe_Gfx_SpriteObject_AttachToOwner
summary: Resolves the tagged handle at self+0x34, walks the class chain for class g_npc2DActorClassRecords and, on a match, calls its virtual +0x80 with (self->ownerNode, self); returns 0 when the handle is dead or of another class.
evidence: Mirror function maybe_Gfx_SpriteObject_DetachFromOwner at 0x004C6D44 supports the attach/detach reading, but the sibling is itself unconfirmed and there are no callers.

name: maybe_Gfx_SpriteObject_DetachFromOwner
summary: Resolves the owner object through the handle table, checks its class tag against the 3D actor class record, and invokes owner virtual slot 0xB8 with (self+0x30, self) to unregister the sprite object.
evidence: Handle-table lookup on self->callbackSlot, class-tag comparison against g_npc3DActorClassRecord, then virtual call slot 0xB8 with ownerNode and self; owner class still unnamed, so detach semantics remain tentative.

name: maybe_Script_FindRegisteredGlobal
summary: Lazily allocates and initializes a script-side singleton (8 words, class tag from 0x293A00) when the cache flag is set, then hashes the VM object and walks the engine hash bucket to return the registered instance.
evidence: One-shot init keyed by *cacheFlag, allocation via 0x0011CFAC, class tag store, then hash-table bucket walk comparing type id; callees include Ui_ReleaseOwnedObjects and a no-op stub, so script-global semantics remain uncertain.
